mistake_reason: At step 7, SocialMediaAnalytics_Expert encountered ambiguous and conflicting LinkedIn data (official page snippet showed only “500+ connections,” while reputable third-party sources indicated >1.3M followers). Instead of asking for clarification, requesting a logged-in verification, or reconciling discrepancies with the verification expert, the agent treated the truncated "500+ connections" (connections ≠ followers) as the definitive LinkedIn audience size. This directly exemplifies FM-2.2: failing to request additional information when faced with unclear or incomplete data and relying on a clearly incomplete snippet to draw a conclusion, leading to the incorrect final answer that Twitter/X has the most followers.
